name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
